title: From Burdened to Baptized
description: In this powerful testimony, a husband shares his journey from spiritual skepticism to surrender, as his wife's unwavering faith and supernatural experiences ultimately lead him to discover the life-changing power of Jesus Christ. Through the story of their revival meetings and the Bible's clear guidance, Pastor Chris Zehner will unpack the transformative power of surrender and baptism, challenging listeners to examine their own hearts and consider what it means to truly surrender to God. Join us as we explore the joy, freedom, and radical transformation that await those who say yes to Jesus.
